'''Taggart''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who serving in the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Taggart was in command of a detachment of Senate Guards who escorted [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] on the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 short hauler]] [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']] for a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] between the Separatists and the Republic. During the peace talks, Taggart's Guards repelled [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]], enabling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], along with former Separatist [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] to escape Mandalore.

==Biography==
Taggart was an individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Taggart served in the Republic's [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] and held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="FiN" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FiN Date">{{TCWdates|414}}</ref> [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] hosted a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] on her<ref name="FiN" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EpGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep414|text="A Friend in Need" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> in order to find a peaceful solution that would end the war between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Taggart, along with several Senate Guards and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] flew to Mandalore, to protect the Republic delegation, consisting of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. During the conference in<ref name="FiN" /> the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]],<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> Taggart and their troops were assigned to stand guard at [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari shipping docks]], protecting the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']]; the Republic delegation's<ref name="FiN" /> [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]],<ref name="Myth Creatures 1">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-imagination-mythological-creatures-in-star-wars-part-1|text=Drawing from the Imagination: Mythological Creatures in ''Star Wars'', Part 1|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> while the conference transpired in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]].<ref name="FiN" />

[[File:GuardsVsDroids-Mandalore.png|thumb|left|250px|Taggart and his Guards fight against the droid commandos.]]
During the peace talks, Tano, along with the former Separatist, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], arrived at where Taggart and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were standing guard. Tano had just rescued Bonteri from a potential [[Death/Legends|execution]] by the Separatists for interrupting the peace conference, and the two adolescents were subsequently chased by Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]]. After Tano informed Taggart that the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were pursuing her and Bonteri, the captain and their troops responded by giving the two teenagers cover fire to safely reach the ''Phoenix'', which directed the attention of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Multiple casualties were suffered by both opponents in the resulting [[lightfight]].<ref name="FiN" />

==Personality and traits==
Taggart served in the Senate Guard,<ref name="FiN" /> a unit that was trained in the protection of Republic officials.<ref name="Senate Guard">{{DB|organization|senateguard|Senate Guard}}</ref> While Lux Bonteri and Ahsoka Tano were pursued by Separatist commando droids during the peace conference on Mandalore, Taggart helped the adolescents escape the planet and their forces repelled the opposing commando droids.<ref name="FiN" />

==Equipment==
The captain wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] Senate Guard [[Armor/Legends|armor]], a blue [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], which had a dark visor and a ceremonial black plume. Taggart was also armed with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="FiN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taggart first appeared in the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', debuting in "[[A Friend in Need]]," the fourteenth episode of the show's [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]],<ref name="EpGuide" /> which premiered on [[January 13]], [[2012]].<ref name="Insider 130: Launch Pad">{{InsiderCite|130|Launchpad}}</ref> The captain was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].<ref name="FiN" />
